STORE_STATE_VERSION is the existing compatibility boundary; the campaign advances it to 10 and persistenceContract.test.ts guards transient engine fields.
The old scanner hardcoded contract lists and sampled only selected functions; capabilityGraph.test.ts now derives intents, impacts, and phases from source declarations and registries.
Integration coverage now includes intentProductionPath.test.ts through the authoritative collection/resolution path rather than relying only on direct executePipeline calls.
InfrastructureHandler resolves facility upgrades against entityId-owned player or NPC facility maps and records NPC facility investment on the owning StableAIState.

intentCapabilityWaivers.ts explicitly classifies lifecycle, player-expression, system-mediated, and NPC-world intents instead of forcing impossible symmetry.
Vitest discovers src/**/*.test.ts(x), excludes Playwright specs, and only redirects mirrored test imports when the source file exists.
Root, start, compare, and rival-career route pages moved to src/components/routes while route files remain adapters.
protectedArtifacts.test.ts verifies ignored .jules artifacts, tracked tool directories, and exclusion of generated routeTree.gen.ts.

Validated claiming intents are persisted by claimRegistrationPhase, consumed once, and resolved only by claimResolutionPhase; winner-only payment, no refunds, shared same-day cash budgets, canonical player attribution, and NPC outcome learning are covered by claimingLifecycle.test.ts.

Race.claimingPrice is the sole canonical contract; fileRaceClaim, race-entry steps, badges, and ClaimingRacePanel use it. RaceFeed.claiming.test.ts proves claim filing is reachable without a player entry and pending claims render before registration.
INTENT_TYPE_CONTRACTS is compile-checked against AnyIntent, ALL_VALIDATORS includes StructuralIntentValidator, and composed validation rejects malformed recognized and unknown intents.
descriptorRuntimeContract.test.ts instruments a representative executor day and fails on any undeclared top-level GameState read or write; descriptors were reconciled to observed behavior.
runNpcCycle returns structured NpcCycleDiagnostic records and npcCyclePhase appends them to day logs without console.error or one-stable failure aborting the cycle.
Weather, foaling, and jockey generator tests now assert real seasonal modifiers and deterministic production instead of unconditional success.

advancedAiPipeline.test.ts now uses typed full GameState/StableAIState fixtures and a production SimulationExecutor assertion for action plans/traces; fixtureQuality.test.ts rejects partial state and any casts in designated campaign suites.
intentCollection now explicitly depends on and requires worldAssessment in the compiled descriptor schedule; the full-state runtime contract confirms no undeclared reads or writes.

calculateUtilityAdjustment preserves each domain score's 0-100 scale and applies a bounded signed personality adjustment; claiming, auction, training, market, campaign, and jockey decisions no longer discard semantic base values for a 0-1 utility fraction.
economyInvariant.test.ts reconciles the complete player cash delta from cash_change and player insurance_payout impacts, exposing the previously unclassified positive payout source.
facilityWeights, insuranceIntents, crossSystemLoops, and designated campaign suites use complete typed Stable/GameState fixtures; fixtureQuality.test.ts rejects partial casts in those files.
